name: FitHub
reference: 白色手机、黑色细线、淡紫统计卡和醒目黄操作构成极简训练管理体验
prompt: 极简健身 App 视觉参考：白色 390×844 现代 iPhone 画布、黑色无衬线大标题、细线图标、淡紫与浅蓝统计卡、亮黄主按钮；训练教练与目标部位运动员使用两张独立无文字 image2 人像摄影。所有文字、状态栏、日期、卡片数字、按钮、标签、底部导航、箭头和图标均由代码呈现；不在图片中生成文字、logo、水印、手机或 UI glyph。
summary: 以课程发现、每日活动和目标部位三屏串起训练流程，让黑白骨架、低饱和数据色和黄色下一步保持清晰分工。
bestFor: 运动训练、健身计划、习惯打卡、个人活动记录
palette: 云白 / 墨黑 / 淡紫 / 浅蓝 / 活力黄
layout: 训练发现 + 活动统计 + 目标部位选择

recipe.principle: 把一天的训练决策分成三件短事：选课程、读状态、定目标。
recipe.image: 训练人物和运动员肖像为独立无文字生成图，所有操作与数据都保留在代码层。
recipe.type: 标题使用大写无衬线和直接数字，辅助标签短且固定在稳定栅格中。
recipe.components: 19.5:9 iOS 机身、课程筛选、可点训练卡、活动指标、日期选择、目标部位标签和底部导航。
recipe.motion: 筛选、日期、目标和底部导航都用即时选中态与短反馈回应。
recipe.avoid: 过多彩色统计卡、密集运动数据、生成图内 UI 文本和无法返回的多步流程。

en.reference: A white phone, fine black lines, pale-violet stat cards, and bold yellow actions form a minimal workout-management experience
en.prompt: Minimal fitness-app visual reference: a white 390×844 modern iPhone canvas, large black sans-serif headings, fine-line icons, pale-violet and light-blue statistics cards, and a bright-yellow primary button. Use two separate text-free image2 portraits for the trainer and target-area athlete. Render all copy, status bars, dates, card numbers, buttons, labels, bottom navigation, arrows, and icons in code; do not generate text, logos, watermarks, phones, or UI glyphs inside images.
en.summary: Course discovery, daily activity, and target-area screens connect the workout flow while black-and-white structure, muted data colors, and yellow next steps keep distinct roles.
en.bestFor: Exercise training, fitness plans, habit check-ins, personal activity tracking
en.palette: Cloud white / Ink black / Pale violet / Light blue / Energy yellow
en.layout: Workout discovery + Activity stats + Target-area selection

recipe.principle: Break the day's workout decision into three short tasks: choose a class, read the status, and set a target.
recipe.image: Use separate text-free generated portraits for the trainer and athlete; keep every action and data point in the code layer.
recipe.type: Use large sans-serif headings and direct numbers; keep supporting labels short and anchored to a stable grid.
recipe.components: 19.5:9 iOS frame, course filters, tappable workout cards, activity metrics, date selection, target-area labels, and bottom navigation.
recipe.motion: Respond to filters, dates, targets, and bottom navigation with immediate selected states and brief feedback.
recipe.avoid: Avoid too many colored stat cards, dense exercise data, UI text embedded in generated images, and multi-step flows with no way back.
